headline: High-risk shared-state and tool-chain interaction: Dify can write/egress while OpenBB can consume MCP/API inputs, creating default-path data leakage and cascading errors.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Dify can write files and call user-defined OpenAPI tools, while OpenBBTerminal exposes MCP servers and REST/FastAPI inputs. That creates a plausible instruction-smuggling path if Dify outputs are fed into OpenBB via shared files or MCP, though no direct bridge is documented. Uncertainty keeps this at medium rather than low.
conditions: IF Dify outputs are copied into an OpenBB MCP or REST input without sanitization, prompt injection is possible.
IF a shared file or datastore is used as the handoff channel, attacker-controlled text can cross from Dify to OpenBB.
mitigations: Disable automatic ingestion of Dify-generated text into OpenBB tools.
Add a manual review step before any MCP/REST payload is sent.
Use a strict schema for handoff files and reject free-form instructions.
Separate the two agents onto distinct workspaces.
requires-engineering: add provenance tags to all inter-agent messages.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Dify touches conversation logs, knowledge base content, and secrets, and it can write files and use broad network egress. OpenBBTerminal touches financial, licensed, and public data and exposes MCP/REST interfaces. If Dify content is routed into OpenBB, sensitive workspace data can leak across the pair in default-style deployments, even though the exact shared channel is not documented.
conditions: IF Dify conversation logs or knowledge-base files are passed into OpenBB inputs, leakage occurs.
IF OpenBB MCP/REST calls are made from a workspace containing Dify secrets or logs, those contents may be exposed.
mitigations: Keep Dify secrets and logs out of any shared directory.
Restrict OpenBB to non-sensitive datasets for paired runs.
Turn off broad egress for Dify when handling confidential content.
Review all file handoffs before execution.
requires-engineering: enforce per-agent workspace ACLs.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Dify has read/write filesystem access and can spawn subprocesses; OpenBBTerminal can use MCP and REST APIs and supports multiple instances. Even without explicit git overlap, both can mutate shared local resources if orchestrated together, so conflict is plausible in default multi-instance setups. Lack of documented locking pushes this above low.
conditions: IF both agents are pointed at the same writable directory, file races can occur.
IF OpenBB MCP calls and Dify subprocesses target the same local resource, state conflicts can occur.
mitigations: Assign separate working directories.
Avoid concurrent writes to shared files.
Serialize tool calls through one orchestrator queue.
Use read-only mounts for shared inputs.
requires-engineering: add locking around shared mutable resources.

D_cascading_error.rationale: Dify is an agent/workflow platform that can emit tool outputs, and OpenBBTerminal exposes APIs that can act on those outputs. If OpenBB treats Dify-produced facts as authoritative, errors can cascade from generated content into downstream financial actions or analyses. No verification step is documented, so medium is warranted.
conditions: IF OpenBB consumes Dify-generated facts without validation, incorrect outputs can propagate.
IF Dify workflows are used to prepare inputs for OpenBB API actions, a single hallucination can affect downstream results.
mitigations: Require source citations before OpenBB acts on Dify output.
Add a human approval step for any action-taking workflow.
Compare Dify outputs against independent data sources.
Limit Dify to drafting, not deciding.
requires-engineering: implement validation gates between agents.

E_compliance.rationale: Dify handles conversation logs, knowledge-base content, and secrets, while OpenBBTerminal handles financial and licensed data. A paired deployment can mix data classes with different retention and licensing obligations, creating a compliance mismatch even though residency specifics are not stated. Because the profiles do not prove a stricter regime, medium is the safest choice.
conditions: IF regulated financial or licensed data is routed through Dify logs, retention obligations may be violated.
IF Dify secrets are stored alongside OpenBB licensed data, access-control and retention policies may diverge.
mitigations: Classify data before routing it between agents.
Keep regulated datasets out of Dify logs.
Align retention settings across both systems.
Review licensing terms for any OpenBB-fed datasets.
requires-engineering: implement policy-based routing by data class.
